scope: Primary-source verification for rendering; dated snapshots, with no claim of exhaustive recency.

indicators.title: Fully AI-generated music's share of Deezer streams
indicators.date_note: The release's FAQ dates its figures to August 2026; the stream-share sampling window is unspecified.
indicators.population: Streams on Deezer; fully AI-generated tracks identified by Deezer's proprietary detector.

chart.title: Fully AI-generated music accounts for 1-3% of Deezer streams
chart.range_type: Publisher-reported range; not a confidence interval
chart.rendering_note: Show both endpoints. Do not substitute a 2% midpoint or draw a trend.
chart.source_locator: Notes to editors, AI and fraud paragraph; FAQ date note. Values appear in prose.

context_only.metric: Fully AI-generated share of daily uploads
context_only.role: Supply context; a different denominator from streams

context_only.metric: Fraud among streams of fully AI-generated tracks
context_only.role: Do not use this historical upper bound to calculate an organic share from the 2026 interval

indicators.what_it_shows: A small recorded stream share on one platform, despite substantial AI-generated supply.
flags: Platform-reported: proprietary detection, not an independent audit.
Recorded streams do not establish human listening; fraud adjustment is unspecified.
Detected AI tracks are excluded from algorithmic recommendations and editorial playlists, limiting reach.
Fully AI-generated music only; do not generalize to all AI-assisted music or other platforms.
indicators.recommendation: Use the interval as the main chart and peak-day upload share as context.

related_evidence.title: Generative AI enhances individual creativity but reduces the collective diversity of novel content
related_evidence.population: Online randomized short-story experiment: 293 writers and 600 separate evaluators; GPT-4 idea access.

raw_values.treatment: Access to up to five AI ideas
Access to up to five AI ideas

source_figure.locator: Figure 2 and results text, printed page 3; study design Figure 1, page 2
source_figure.note: Effects above are transcribed from results text, not estimated from bar heights.

related_evidence.what_it_shows: AI idea access improved individual story ratings while assisted stories were more similar to one another.
flags: One bounded experiment, not a population trend in cultural diversity.
Percentage changes in rating indices are not percentage-point changes or shares of creative people.
No unverified numeric diversity effect is supplied.
related_evidence.recommendation: Use as supporting experimental evidence, separate from the Deezer snapshot.
